title: Independently re-review split allocator completion guard from #446
body:
## Goal
Report, do not fix. Independently review the narrow #446 correction of #443 finding 1: split_allocate.py --check must fail if its rejecting self-tests do not complete. Expected gain: a pinned closed/open verdict for this deferred finding, allowing the next shaper to settle this preparation prerequisite. No session can run LabVIEW. Synthetic allocation checks establish neither native benchmark readiness nor product permission. Do not edit repository files.
## Acceptance
- [ ] Resolve prepared accepted checkout 8aefb1583265f097a8569d76b4f8e5a0b0782833 and its tree with git; record actual reviewed commit/tree and current starting identity. Match benchmark/scripts/split_allocate.py SHA256 55c236ada2bce447990c7185ac8654a2c8aefba32ae4010fac65ae82a15c8ecd and benchmark/split/allocation.synthetic.json SHA256 70d94d28084b45938c698e6097c8afd40934f8e9ab0d70a29de36d242ab4de34 from #446. Report drift rather than silently reviewing substitute bytes.
- [ ] Read original #443 finding 1 and #446 task/report. Resolve original script bytes with SHA256 79ffbdffe60bc589be172de08a380a958ae4e220ee4d53303390f49230ae16fc through git history; compare the actual patch, identify its accepted commit and baseline, and distinguish administrative changes. If historical evidence is unavailable, state the limitation.
- [ ] Independently rerun the ordinary --check and confirm all required reason and mutation self-tests complete. Recreate early return before reason self-test, early return before mutations, disabled expected-reason comparison, split-group duplicate-skipping fault, and missing infeasible_strata field (original #443 probe d) in isolated temporary copies. Require nonzero exit and meaningful diagnostics; independently add a bounded adjacent incomplete-completion case. Record exact mutation, exit and reason; retain legitimate allocation behavior and unchanged synthetic allocation bytes.
- [ ] Repeat normal verification from another working directory with empty environment; confirm no LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT, network, restricted data or session artifacts are needed. Check no protected protocol/index/status/input files changed. Separate Standards and Spec findings with severity, line evidence, reproduction and consequence.
- [ ] Give finding 1 an explicit closed/open verdict and overall recommendation limited to the pinned completion guard. Report any regression without fixing it; save lengthy evidence under .session/artifacts/ and enough in the report for a cold shaper. Do not repeat allocator specification review, F3 enumeration, global gap maps, POC analysis or writing-method review. No evaluator/policy changes, readiness promotion, owner acceptance request or git commit; parent commits.
## Verification
python3 -I -B benchmark/scripts/split_allocate.py --check
## Context
- .session/history/sessions/446/801938d5f737a0abf412d1b657ecc062427d7c15bcf32e6f363c8b4bad72f7d2.md: accepted author correction with original/final hashes and four reported fault probes; independent review remains outstanding.
- Exported #443 and #446 reports: original finding and correction evidence.
- docs/perpetua/evaluation.md and roles.md: independent review and readiness boundaries.
## Budget
Read .session/exports/manifest.json; exported reports #443 and #446; .session/history/sessions/443/task.md and 446/task.md; benchmark/scripts/split_allocate.py; benchmark/split/allocation.synthetic.json only bounded relevant excerpts; docs/perpetua/evaluation.md and roles.md; at most three directly linked specification excerpts needed to interpret the completion guard. Inspect git identities/diffs and hashes with short output, not whole history or large JSON dumps. Use temporary copies for probes and keep original tracked bytes unchanged. Report early if pinned evidence is missing.
